messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'ceresdata-prod' (tenant: CeresData, vpc: eu-west-1) GPU utilization >= 98% for 7m, queue length 420. Autoscale attempts failed (max_capacity reached). Paging on-call SRE.

Mark Rivera: I'm taking this. Paging Priya for runbook help. oncall handoff: Mark -> Priya.

Priya Singh: On it. looking at console now — seeing spike from batch-embed jobs around 11:10 UTC. Any deploys? @Alice?

Alice Chen: No deploys. Customer reported large nightly ingest earlier. I can reach out to account team.

Ryan O'Neill: Posting relevant metrics snapshot:

```
pool: ceresdata-prod
active_gpus: 32/32
gpu_util: 98.7%
run_queue: 423
avg_latency: 320ms -> 800ms tail
burst_enabled: false (reserved)
autoscale_attempts: 3 (failed due to quota)
```

Jessica Park: Confirmed burst policy for this tenant is "manual-approval". They don't have burst SLA by contract. Customer contact: @Alice will confirm if ops can approve temporary burst.

Priya Singh: Two mitigation paths:
1) Approve emergency burst to DedicatedReserve-XL (adds +8 GPUs) — requires Ops approval and billing sign-off.
2) Evict non-critical single-tenant jobs (batch embeds) and fallback customer realtime traffic to hosted-compatible model (model-compat proxy) — lower latency but may increase cost.

Mark Rivera: I'm starting eviction of low-priority batch pods for tenant. Command:
`kubectl label pod embedder-* eviction=critical && ./drain-pods --selector=eviction=critical --tenant=ceresdata-prod`
Will keep realtime pods pinned.

incident-bot: Note: eviction command queued by Mark at 1758502520.

Alice Chen: I've messaged CeresData account team to ask to pause ingest. They replied "we can pause ingestion for 30m", turning off pipeline now.

Priya Singh: While eviction is progressing, enabling model-fallback route for realtime: adding route to hosted "gpt-medium-compatible" with rate limit 200rps. Config snippet:

```
route add ceresdata-realtime -> hosted/gpt-medium-compatible
limit: 200rps
timeout: 15s
fallback_condition: queue_length>200
```

Ryan O'Neill: Eviction completed 1758502605. Run queue dropped to 130. GPU utilization -> 86%. Tail latency improving.

Mark Rivera: Can we approve +8 burst to be safe? Ops/billing?

Jessica Park: Ops approves temporary burst for 2 hours. Billing flagged and sent invoice approval. Granting burst now.

incident-bot: Burst activated: +8 GPUs applied at 1758502688. New capacity: 40 GPUs.

Priya Singh: Monitoring: queue now 12, gpu_util 54%, avg latency 220ms. Recommend keep burst for 1 hour, then re-evaluate after customer resume.

Alice Chen: CeresData paused ingest. They appreciate the quick action. They requested postmortem and cost estimates.

Mark Rivera: Going to close paging in 15m if stable. @incident-bot please set incident status -> monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> monitoring at 1758502790. Paging cleared to on-call.

Jessica Park: Noted. I'll prep brief cost impact and notify account execs.

Priya Singh: Reminder for follow-up: confirm customer's long-term plan (increase reserved capacity, convert to dedicated burst SLA, or throttle batch pipelines). I'll draft runbook updates.

Mark Rivera: Thanks team. Adding brief to postmortems channel after wrap-up.
